code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("rlechtenberg/kcHARS")

title: Functions for reading and working with eHARS data
text: kcHARS assumes eHARS SAS datasets reside “//KC/DPH/Prevention/HIV/Epi/EXTRA SPACE/eHARS/Full eHARS” (ehars_root_dir() returns). Specifically, assumes Archive/ subdirectory contains folders named ‘YYYY-MM-DD’, containing extract different date, contains person_sas7bdat/ subdirectory containing eHARS’ person-based dataset (AKA person view) document_sas7bdat/ subdirectory containing document-based datasets. load attach kcHARS package using library() function, R identifies date recent archived eHARS extract, stores global option named kcHARS.ehars_dt, notifies via package start-message. Calls read_ehars_person() read_ehars_doc() read requested data associated folder. want use data different/older extract, can simply update kcHARS.ehars_dt global option using options(kcHARS.ehars_dt = '<YYYY-MM-DD>').
code: library(kcHARS) #> Using eHARS data dated 2026-11-02.  #> (You can specify a different date using `options(kcHARS.ehars_dt = '<YYYY-MM-DD>')`.  # print date of eHARS data being used getOption("kcHARS.ehars_dt") #> [1] "2026-11-02"  # get max document enter_dt read_ehars_doc("document", col_select = c("enter_dt")) |>   dplyr::pull(enter_dt) |>   max() |>   ehars_dt.as.Date() #> [1] "2026-10-30" options(kcHARS.ehars_dt = "2025-12-30")  # print date of eHARS data being used getOption("kcHARS.ehars_dt") #> [1] "2025-12-30"  # get max document enter_dt read_ehars_doc("document", col_select = c("enter_dt")) |>   dplyr::pull(enter_dt) |>   max() |>   ehars_dt.as.Date() #> [1] "2025-12-23"
